name: Roasted Sweet Potato Bowl
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp smoked paprika
Dressing: juice of 1 lime, 2 tbsp plain unsweetened soy yogurt, salt, pepper
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the sweet potato, chickpeas and tofu with the oil and spices.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once, until the sweet potato is tender and the chickpeas crisp.
Divide the spinach and quinoa between two bowls.
Top with the roasted mixture and drizzle with the dressing.
note: Sweet potato has a moderate glycaemic load; pairing it with legumes, tofu and fibre slows the rise.
